response.text: {"anomaly_detected": false, "confidence": 0.6, "anomalies": [], "summary": "I checked the power tree, USB and CC pulls, TPS2121 and AP63203 pin wiring, the TPS1H200 heater switch, the three MAX31855 channels (shared SCK/SO, independent CS to GPIO4/6/7, correct thermocouple polarity), the fan-tach protection and pull-ups, the strapping pins, and the R/C values against their roles and the SPICE deck. Each is consistent with the specification and sound practice. The reference-designator and connector names differ from the specification in many places, but that appears to be a naming difference rather than a deviation, so I did not report it."}
